title: Customer Portals
meta: A secure customer area where people see their orders, files and updates. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Customer portals with secure logins and live updates
overview: We build a private area on your website where customers sign in to see their orders, invoices, files, messages or project progress. Each customer sees only their own information. We connect it to the system where your records live, add email notifications for changes and style it to match your brand, so customers stop emailing to ask for updates.

pkgs.blurb: A secure portal with login and one customer view.
list: Data loaded from a sheet or export

pkgs.blurb: Orders, files and messages in one place, with email alerts.
A full portal connected to your systems, with admin tools.

faq: With an email and password by default, plus a reset link. Premium also supports sign-in with Google or Microsoft. We never see customer passwords, because they are stored as secure hashes.
Can it connect to Shopify, QuickBooks or our CRM?
Often yes, where the tool offers an API. Tell us what you use in the order form and we confirm what can be connected before starting. Some systems limit what data can be shared.
Each customer can only open their own records, connections are encrypted and the portal runs in your own cloud account. We also test that one customer cannot reach another's data.
Yes, in the Standard and Premium packages, with limits on file size and type. Files are stored privately and shown only to the customer and your team.
